items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I just came from her house and brought my elder sister back to her house just now.

ctx.x: I just came from her house and brought my elder sister back to her house just now. She didn't keep the place anymore. Oh, I didn't? Because they put hardwoods for her, it was giving her too much trouble. Yeah.

So she gave it up. Is she older than you or? No, she's younger than you. Younger than you. Yeah, she's younger than you. I thought maybe in case she was older, she might have known a good deal about your father too. Some things maybe you would have forgotten. No, she's younger than you. She'd be younger than you. Yeah, she's younger than you. I would have known as well as you. I know.
